title: Solar Flux and Geomagnetic Index
text: Return solar flux and geomagnetic index, 4 inputs, 3 outputs, {F10.7 extrapolation method} sets Extrapolation method for f107Average and f107Daily None -; {Space weather data file} sets the mAT file of space weather data, {Input time specification} sets the input time format Year, {F10.7 extrapolation value} sets the extrapolation value to assign to f107Average and to calculate, {Magnetic index extrapolation method} sets the extrapolation method for magnetic index information None and {Magnetic index extrapolation value} sets the extrapolation value used to calculate magnetic index. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: F107
ports.summary: Daily F10.7 flux for previous day scalar

params.name: Space weather data file
params.values: MAT file of space weather data aeroSpaceWeatherData.mat (default) | MAT file name

params.name: Input time specification
params.values: Input time format Year, day, sec (default) | Julian date

params.name: F10.7 extrapolation method
params.values: Extrapolation method for f107Average and f107Daily None - clip (default) | Constant | Least squares fit

params.name: F10.7 extrapolation value
params.values: Extrapolation value to assign to f107Average and to calculate f107Daily 150.0 (default) | scalar

params.name: Magnetic index extrapolation method
params.values: Extrapolation method for magnetic index information None - clip (default) | Constant | IGRF

params.name: Magnetic index extrapolation value
params.values: Extrapolation value used to calculate magnetic index elements 4.0 (default) | scalar
